name: Scientific Research
summary: Two desks: Rho reads new literature against their active projects and tracks what moved on each project; Argus is the bench - one desk for LabSerf's agents (flow/ultrasound analysis, primer and construct design, experiment critique, figure review), each launched from the lab notebook.
notes: Runs in the 05:00 morning window, before the owner's planning hour. The hour lives in .claude/agents/day-schedule.json, not here - run_at only places this team in agent_day.py's morning half.

Unpublished work lives in VAULT/Research-Private/. The dispatcher derives sensitivity from the payload path, so a job touching that tree is forced onto ollama regardless of what this manifest says - the ceiling here is documentation, the guard in dispatch.py is enforcement.
lit_review on a public arXiv paper is internal and may use the claude CLI; the same job on an unpublished manuscript is private and stays local.

Argus is one bench desk for LabSerf's four agents - labserf (flow/ultrasound analysis), cloner (primers/constructs), advisor (experiment critique and the negative-result ledger) and figure-designer (figure review). They are separate agents in labserf/.claude/agents (LABSERF_ROOT overrides) and the lab notebook keeps their own names; /teams shows one seat. Argus's status aggregates the lab runner's run files (.claude/data/state/lab-runs/) across every assay, with the negative-result ledger as the resting note. Runs are explicit per-run launches from /research/notebook on their subscription, never the dispatcher. The model chips keep the policy kinds research.lab_analysis and research.lab_cloning.
research.next_actions is retired: the producer no longer emits it; the module stays registered so its history still groups under this team.
